```plato
    // True when edge e was accepted: all four of its vertices carry its own number.
    IsAcceptedFlip(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology, claims: Array<Integer>, e: Integer): Boolean
    {
        var pair = topology.UndirectedEdges[e];
        var near = self.EdgeApex(topology, UndirectedEdgeIndex(e));
        var far = self.EdgeFarApex(topology, UndirectedEdgeIndex(e));
        return far.IsPresent
            .And(claims[pair.A.Value] == e)
            .And(claims[pair.B.Value] == e)
            .And(claims[near.Value] == e)
            .And(ClaimAt(claims, far) == e);
    }
```
